question: Why does Costco end its fiscal year on the Sunday nearest the end of August?
settings: model openrouter:openai/gpt-oss-20b, temperature 0.6, reasoning effort low, max_tokens 700; retriever hybrid, k 8, question text only, no filters
answer: Costco explains that its fiscal year is structured on a 52‑ or 53‑week basis and is deliberately aligned with the seasonal cycle of its business.  The company states that the year ends on the Sunday nearest August 31 so that its reporting periods match the retail calendar, allowing the company to capture the full winter holiday season (the period with the greatest sales and earnings) in the fourth quarter.  This alignment also simplifies internal planning and financial reporting across the 13 four‑week periods that make up the year.  The filing notes: “The Company operates on a 52/53‑week fiscal year, consisting of thirteen four‑week periods and ending on the Sunday nearest the end of August. … The material seasonal impact in our operations is increased net sales and earnings during the winter holiday season.”[5]

citations.quote: The Company operates e-commerce sites in the U.S., Canada, Mexico, the U.K., Korea, Taiwan, Japan, and Australia. Our common stock trades on the NASDAQ Global Select Market, under the symbol “COST.”
citations.text:
The Company operates e-commerce sites in the U.S., Canada, Mexico, the U.K., Korea, Taiwan, Japan, and Australia. Our common stock trades on the NASDAQ Global Select Market, under the symbol “COST.”

We report on a 52/53-week fiscal year, consisting of thirteen four-week periods and ending on the Sunday nearest the end of August. The first three quarters consist of three periods each, and the fourth quarter consists of four periods (five weeks in the thirteenth period in a 53-week year). The material seasonal impact in our operations is increased net sales and earnings during the winter holiday season. References to 2024 and 2022 relate to the 52-week fiscal years ended September 1, 2024, and August 28, 2022. References to 2023 relate to the 53-week fiscal year ended September 3, 2023.
